name: Naomi Fairchild
source: Circuit boards, cathode ray tubes, joysticks, buttons, pixels… Naomi loves arcade games with deep affection, bringing good cheer to the Funplex. She’s shy around crowds but perfectly happy to tinker away in solitude.
